Hi Alex —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery: Acme Analytics is prioritizing inference cost reduction for batch scoring and lower-latency interactive features for your analytics product. Next best step is a technical deep-dive with Monica to cover architecture, model variants, and expected throughput so we can provide sizing and an optimized quote.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue Aug 3, 10:00–11:00am
- Wed Aug 4, 2:00–3:00pm

Do either of those work? If not, send a couple times that fit your calendar and we’ll accommodate. I’ll attach the demo slides and a draft mutual action plan for the call.
